title: Russia prepares for ‘massive strikes’ against Ukraine's energy facilities
summary_full: Amid rising tensions, Russia announced plans for large-scale attacks aimed at Ukraine's energy infrastructure, following strikes on its own civilian areas. A recent attack in Bucha tragically resulted in thirty-seven fatalities. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy called out perceived negligence in ammunition storage practices. As these aerial campaigns escalate, the region faces a deepening crisis with infrastructure under relentless assault.
